name: Somchai Srisawat
bio:
Somchai's journey into motorsport security began unconventionally. After a stint in the Royal Thai Police specializing in VIP protection, a chance encounter with a Red Bull Racing representative at a charity event led to a job offer. He quickly adapted his skills to the fast-paced world of Formula 1, recognizing the unique security challenges posed by high-profile events and valuable assets. 

His approach centers on meticulous planning and proactive risk assessment. Somchai believes in building strong relationships with local authorities and internal stakeholders to ensure seamless security operations. His dedication to preventing security breaches and ensuring the safety of the team is unwavering, making him a valuable asset to Red Bull Racing. Somchai is known for his calm demeanor under pressure and his ability to anticipate potential problems before they arise.

physical.hairStyle: short, neatly combed back with a slight wave
physical.description: Somchai is a wiry man with a focused gaze and a confident posture.

quirks: Always carries a small Buddha amulet for good luck.
Insists on personally checking every security camera feed at least once per day.
Fluent in Thai, English, and German, often switches languages mid-sentence when stressed.
